outcomes.rule_text: alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"ET SCAN Potential TCP Port Scan"; flags:S; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 60, seconds 300; classtype:attempted-recon; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET 2222 (msg:"Potential SSH Brute Force / Scanning Attempt"; flow:to_server; flags:S; threshold: type threshold, track by_src, count 10, seconds 300; classtype:attempted-recon; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert http $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"SCAN Gobuster Directory Brute Force Tool Detected"; flow:to_server,established; http.user_agent; content:"gobuster"; nocase; threshold:type both, track by_src, count 30, seconds 300; classtype:web-application-attack; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert udp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET 53 (msg:"ET DOS Inbound DNS Query Flood (flood-test.example)"; dns.query; content:"flood-test.example"; nocase; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 100, seconds 60; classtype:denial-of-service; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"SCAN TCP SYN Port Scan Detected"; flags:S; threshold: type both, track by_src, count 141, seconds 300; classtype:attempted-recon; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert tcp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET 2222 (msg:"Potential SSH Brute Force Inbound"; flow:to_server; flags:S; threshold: type both, track by_src, count 10, seconds 300; classtype:attempted-recon; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert http $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET any (msg:"SCAN Gobuster Web Directory Brute Force Tool Detected"; flow:established,to_server; http.user_agent; content:"gobuster"; nocase; threshold:type threshold, track by_src, count 5, seconds 300; classtype:web-application-attack; sid:1000000; rev:1;)

alert udp $EXTERNAL_NET any -> $HOME_NET 53 (msg:"DOS High Volume Inbound DNS Query Flood"; threshold: type both, track by_src, count 100, seconds 60; classtype:denial-of-service; sid:1000000; rev:1;)
